fdc.title: Friday Dress Code
fdc.loginToVote: Log in with the login button to vote here, or react on Discord.
fdc.votersPrivate: Voter identities are only available to logged-in users.
fdc.archiveIntroduction: Browse previous polls and their results. Anyone can see the results; who voted is only shown to logged-in users.
fdc.summaryError: Could not load FDC polls. Please try again later.
fdc.noCurrentPoll: There is no running FDC poll right now.
fdc.offline: Live data is unavailable right now, so voting is paused. You can still vote on Discord.
fdc.voteSynced: Votes here and on Discord are synced.

create.title: New FDC poll
create.intro: The bot sends the poll to the FDC channel, pings the FDC role and archives the images. Pick an image to crop it; the bot adds the number and emoji to the Discord copy only.
create.doneNote: The bot posted it in the FDC channel and saved it to the archive.

errors.type: Option {{number}} must be an image or GIF.
errors.size: Option {{number}}'s image is larger than 10 MB.
errors.emoji: Each option needs a different emoji.
errors.end: Pick an end time in the future.

create.queuedNote: The server is unreachable right now, so the poll was saved as a draft in this browser. Send it from the drafts list once the server is back.
create.reasonTomorrow: the usual FDC close, the next morning, so everyone gets a full day to vote
create.reasonHours: {{hours}} hours after you send the poll
create.endsBerlinNote: FDC times are Berlin time; that is {{time}} in Berlin.
create.imageOptional: optional if the option has a name

fdc.hintSwitch: Tap another outfit to switch, or your pick to remove it.
fdc.localAdmin: Local admin session: new polls are saved on this device and can be sent once the server is reachable.
fdc.about: Every Thursday, vote for your favorite Friday Dress Code idea!
fdc.loginUnavailable: Website login is currently unavailable, so vote by reacting on Discord.
fdc.aboutFriday: On Friday, the winner will be announced and you can make your cat look according to it!

editor.title: Edit image
editor.stage: Crop area. Drag or use the arrow keys to move the image, scroll or use + and - to zoom.
editor.gifNote: The preview shows the first frame. The bot applies your edit to every frame, so the GIF stays animated.

manage.title: Manage poll
manage.intro: New images replace the old ones on Discord and in the archive. The bot keeps the option order and adds the number and emoji to the Discord copies only.
manage.closeText: Voting stops right away and the bot posts the results with the votes so far.
manage.discardText: The poll and its images are deleted from Discord and the archive, and all votes are lost. This can’t be undone.
manage.archiveIntro: This poll has ended: changes only update the archive (website, recycling bin). Discord stays as it was.

emoji.title: Choose an emoji
emoji.noRecent: Emojis you pick show up here.
emoji.name: Emoji name
emoji.uploadNote: Saved to the bot’s own emojis, so it can react with it in the server. GIFs stay animated.
emoji.tooBig: The file is larger than 10 MB.
emoji.noFavorites: Right-click (or long-press) an emoji to add it to your favorites.
emoji.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} from the bot? This can’t be undone.

picker.hoursHint: Pick the hour (inner ring 12–23), then the minutes.

recycle.noCandidates: Every option of every ended poll is already in the bin.
recycle.title: Recycling bin
recycle.pickHint: Click an option to put it into option {{number}}. Its name and emoji become suggestions you can keep or change.
recycle.empty: Nothing here yet. Recycle options from ended polls to reuse them later.
recycle.removeText: They can be recycled again later from "Choose to recycle".
recycle.deleteFolderText: The items inside move to "Unsorted"; nothing is lost.
recycle.cleanupAsk: This poll used {{count}} recycled option(s). Remove them from the recycling bin?
recycle.cleanupSelect: Which ones should leave the bin?

external.title: Votes from elsewhere
external.intro: Add votes counted somewhere else, like the Steam group chat (Steam has no API for chat polls, so they are entered by hand). They are added to the results everywhere.

errors.date: Pick the day the FDC ended (today or earlier).
errors.imageOrName: Option {{number}} needs an image or a name.

manual.doneNote: {{options}} options and {{votes}} votes. You can still fix it from the archive (Edit, Add votes).
manual.title: Add a past FDC
manual.intro: For FDCs that only happened elsewhere, like the Steam group chat. It only goes into the archive; nothing is posted on Discord.
manual.question: Question (optional)
manual.winnerNote: When the vote counts are lost: pick the option that won. A single option is the winner.

fdc.winnerOnly: Only the winner of this FDC is known; the vote counts were lost.
